text.index.ts: Turns any element into a popover anchored to its trigger (mountPopover): toggles on click, keeps aria-expanded current, moves focus in on open and back on close, and closes on an outside press, on Escape or when focus leaves, with nested popovers staying open together; also gives a menu arrow-key, Home and End navigation (rovingFocus)
text.index.ts gotcha: Escape closes only the topmost open popover and stops there, so it never reaches the dialog below
